component.name: dsh-pet
dsh-pet 桌宠
component.summary: Desktop pet powered by the dsh-pet renderer
由 dsh-pet 渲染端驱动的桌面宠物

description.p: A transparent, click-through desktop companion that reuses the dsh-pet web renderer (sprite animations, right-click menu, chat bubble) inside a Tauri shell. It runs natively on Wayland as a work-area-sized overlay: the window never moves, the pet does, and everything outside the pet is passed through to the desktop via wl_surface input regions.
把 dsh-pet 的网页渲染端（精灵动画、右键菜单、对话气泡）装进 Tauri 外壳的透明桌宠。 在 Wayland 下以“工作区大小的透明覆盖层”运行：窗口不动、宠物在层内移动， 宠物以外的区域通过 wl_surface input region 穿透给桌面。
